parsed.notes: The filing gives only the covenant thresholds; it does not disclose actual ratio values. It states the Company was in compliance with all financial covenants as of September 30, 2026. The 2.00x pro forma leverage test for restricted payments is a payment condition, not a maintenance covenant, and is excluded. Leverage-based pricing grids are also excluded. The Credit Agreement replaced the Prior Credit Agreement in April 2026; no covenant ratios are given for the prior facility.
